entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to aShoshanim. A Psalm of David.>> Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts: Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword unto them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And [I am] the song of the drunkards.

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness, Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep shallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Ransom me because of mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, [let it become] a trap.

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Let their habitation be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, And not be written with the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, [Or] a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and everything that moveth therein.

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it; And they that love his name shall dwell therein.
